name: Captured Mountaineer
summary: Beneath Brill, a captured Ironforge Mountaineer is held below the Gallows' End Tavern. The Forsaken keep him bound for the Royal Apothecary Society's experiments.

sections.title: A Prisoner in the Cellar
sections.body: An Ironforge Mountaineer is held beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, far from Khaz Modan. Patrons drink above while the Royal Apothecary Society tests its concoctions on him. Apothecary Johaan and his peers measure their developing plague against living Alliance captives. They study how swiftly and painfully the toxins kill.

faq.answer: He is an Alliance scout from Ironforge, held by the Forsaken in the basement of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken keeping him alive in the basement?
aliases: why is he in the tavern
what are they doing to the dwarf
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society keeps him alive as a test subject. Apothecaries such as Johaan give him experimental mixtures to study their effects on living dwarves.

faq.q: What happens to him during the tests?
aliases: what happens in a new plague
faq.answer: The apothecaries force him to swallow concoctions as they develop a new plague. A lethal mixture kills him, revealing the toxin's progress.

faq.q: Who else interacts with him down here?
faq.answer: The Deathguard hold captured mountaineers in the tavern cellar until they can be dealt with. Apothecaries also come there to conduct experiments.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing an Ironforge brother caged beneath a Forsaken tavern and subjected to alchemical trials reveals the Forsaken's hostility toward the living.
As Forsaken, you see living Alliance captives used in the Royal Apothecary Society's effort to perfect a plague against the Scourge and the living.
